## Summary

Describe the change and the user-visible outcome.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior or the PR explains why no test is needed.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries match the implemented behavior.
- [ ] Untrusted paths, manifests, and template contents remain bounded and non-executing.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated build output, or fabricated claims are included.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off with `Signed-off-by: Name <email>` as described in
      `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
